assessment.rationale: AI commentary exists for highlights and recaps, but no live personal commentator explains games in each viewer's language at scale, so the Main KPI of 2,000,000,000 viewers is unmet. IBM watsonx narrated Masters and Wimbledon highlight clips in English or Spanish, not live play, because generation took seconds to minutes (https://www.nbcnews.com/tech/innovation/us-open-ai-sports-commentary-masters-wimbledon-rcna95244). NBC's AI Al Michaels voice produced about 7 million personalised Olympic recaps, human-reviewed before release (https://tvtechnology.com/news/peacock-to-use-ai-generated-al-michaels-for-recaps-of-olympic-games-highlights). Open live attempts report latency of several seconds that lags play (https://getstream.io/blog/ai-football-commentator-lessons/), while research such as LiveCC reports 0.36 s on a generic benchmark (https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2025/supplemental/Chen_LiveCC_Learning_Video_CVPR_2025_supplemental.pdf). World Cup 2026 broadcasters were only testing adaptive AI commentary (https://publication.aimagazine.com/ai-magazine-june-2026-issue-43/0110591001780301552/p98). Honest limit: recap narration and event-driven text commentary are known answers; live accurate multilingual video commentary is open, and broadcast rights limit deployment.

additionalSearches.query: AI generated personalized sports commentary multiple languages live broadcast 2025 IBM Wimbledon Masters AI commentary
additionalSearches.finding: IBM AI commentary covered highlight clips (20,000+ Masters clips, English or Spanish), not live matches; mispronunciation criticism.

additionalSearches.query: NBC Olympics AI Al Michaels personalized recaps; live AI commentary in viewer's language streaming football 2026
additionalSearches.finding: Peacock 2024: AI Al Michaels voiced about 7 million personalised daily recaps, all reviewed by editors; recaps, not live commentary.

additionalSearches.query: real-time AI play-by-play commentary generation research latency open source live sports video LLM
additionalSearches.finding: Open live AI football commentator demo: latency of several seconds, play moved on; LiveCC reports 0.36 s on a generic benchmark.

additionalSearches.query: FIFA World Cup 2026 global audience billions viewers AI features personalized commentary
additionalSearches.finding: World Cup 2026 projected audience in billions; broadcasters testing AI-adapted language feeds; deployment extent unconfirmed.
